mapper.select: SELECT rs.flight_id AS flightId, rs.segment_order AS segmentOrder, rs.snap_cabin_class_code AS cabinClassCode, STR_TO_DATE(rs.snap_departure_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS departureTime FROM reservation_segment rs WHERE rs.reservation_id = #{reservationId} ORDER BY rs.segment_order ASC
